versions.content: The main function for scheduling the CAN TP (Entry point for scheduling) The main function will be called by the Schedule Manager or by th e Free Running Timer module according of the call period needed. CanTp_MainFunction is involved in handling of CAN TP timeouts N_As, N_Bs, N_Cs, N_Ar, N_Br, N_Cr and STMmin.
